y1: The Gospel written by Matthew starts with Jesus' family tree. This is a list of the names of grandfathers and great-grandfathers.
y2: At the very beginning is Abraham, in the middle is King David, and at the very end is Jesus. God promised Abraham and David: 'A blessing will come from your family.'
y3: This promise came true with Jesus.
y5: Mary and Joseph were engaged. They were not living together yet.
y6: One day, it became known that Mary was going to have a baby. This baby came through the Holy Spirit. Only God can do this.
y8: Joseph was a righteous man. He did not want to shame Mary. So he wanted to leave quietly.
y9: That night, an angel came in a dream and said: 'Don't be afraid! Take Mary home. Name the baby Jesus.'
y10: Jesus will save people from their sins.
y12: A long, long time ago, God gave a promise through the prophet Isaiah. This was about 700 years before Jesus.
y13: 'A virgin girl will have a son. They will name him Immanuel.'
y16: Joseph woke up and did what the angel said. He took Mary to his home.
y17: When the baby was born, Joseph named him 'Jesus.' Joseph believed God and obeyed.
verse: “They will call his name Immanuel, which means, ‘God is with us.’”
prayer: Lord God, we thank You for keeping Your promise and sending Jesus. Jesus is always with us. Help us to believe and obey Your word like Joseph did. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: family tree. A list of the names of a family's grandfathers. It's like a tree of the family. Grandfather → father → me. This is a family tree.
d1: Abraham. A man who believed God and listened to His word. God said his family would be as many as the stars in the sky. Abraham left his homeland by God's word.
d2: David. A famous king of Israel. When he was a child, he took care of sheep. David defeated the giant Goliath.
d3: engaged. Two people who promised to marry. Back then, being engaged was as important as the wedding. Engaged people usually got married after about a year.
d4: the Holy Spirit. God's Spirit. We can't see Him, but He does God's work. The Holy Spirit helps us know God.
d5: righteous. A person who is right and good in God's eyes. They tell the truth and love others. Joseph was righteous, so he protected Mary.
d6: angel. A heavenly messenger sent by God. They bring God's word to people. An angel came to Joseph's dream.
d7: sin. Doing what we want instead of what God wants. Lying and hating are also sins. Sin is like a stain on clean clothes.
d8: save. To rescue from danger. The name 'Jesus' also means 'The Lord saves.' Just like we save a friend who falls in the water, Jesus saves us.
d9: prophet. A person who receives a message from God and tells it to people. The prophet Isaiah said beforehand that Jesus would come.
d10: Immanuel. It means 'God is with us.' This is one of Jesus' names. Even when we feel alone, God is with us.
d11: obey. To hear the word and do it. As soon as Joseph woke up, he obeyed.
